title: Entropy applications in cosmology: spacetime thermodynamics, holographic dark energy, entropic gravity and beyond - a review
summary: Entropy has emerged as a key concept at the intersection of gravity, quantum theory, and cosmology, revealing deep connections between geometry, information, and thermodynamics. The realization that black holes are thermodynamic systems, characterized by an entropy proportional to their horizon area, has provided evidence that spacetime itself may possess a microscopic structure. Since then, entropy has acquired a central role across quantum field theory, holography, quantum gravity, and cosmology. In this review, we present a unified account of entropy in gravitational and cosmological…
